signals.text: Wix site with good drone photos; no reviews shown

bestTime: Tue to Thu, 8 to 9am or 4:30 to 5:30pm (office line)

sections.label: Before you dial
sections.body:
Who: Taylor, director at Steadbrook Roofing, Falkirk.
Why them: great drone photos on the site but no reviews shown.
Best time: Tue to Thu, 8 to 9am or 4:30 to 5:30pm (office line).
Ltd company: tick CTPS (and TPS if it's a personal mobile) in the desk before you dial.
What you want: a 15-minute chat, on the phone or you pop in.
Stand up, slow down on your name, and stop talking after every question.

sections.label: If someone else answers
sections.body:
Hi, it's Dean Finlayson, is Taylor about?
_(if they ask what it's about)_ It's about how folk find Steadbrook online. Is Taylor the right person for that, or is it someone else?
_(if Taylor is out)_ No bother. When's the best time to catch them? _(write their name in the note)_

sections.label: Opener
sections.body:
Hi Taylor, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One in Edinburgh. _(slow)_
The reason I'm calling is your website. The drone photos are brilliant, but there's one thing missing that I think costs you jobs. Is now OK for 30 seconds?
_(stop and wait)_
sections.original:
Hi Taylor, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One in Edinburgh. _(slow)_
The reason I'm calling is your website. The drone photos are brilliant, but there's one thing missing that I think costs you jobs. Is now OK for 30 seconds?
_(stop and wait)_

sections.label: Why I'm calling
sections.body:
There are no reviews on it anywhere. When someone's picking a roofer, that's the first thing they look for.
_(if they say go on)_ How much of your work comes from people looking you up first?
sections.original:

sections.label: Questions
sections.body:
Q: Where do most of your new jobs come from just now?
Q: When someone in town searches for what you do, do you know who comes up?
Q: How do people get a quote from you at the moment?
Listen for: relying on word of mouth or WhatsApp, firms they've lost jobs to, quotes that went quiet.

sections.label: If it's a problem for them
sections.body:
That's what I do. I'll do a quick search for your trade and town, screenshot who comes up instead of you, and tell you the three things I'd change. Costs you nothing.
I'm local, I build it myself, and you deal with me, not a call centre.

sections.label: The ask
sections.body:
Easier to show you than explain. Fifteen minutes, on the phone or I'll pop in to you. Tuesday at 8, or Thursday after 5, which is better?
_(if they hesitate)_ No commitment. If it's not for you, no bother at all.

sections.label: If they push back
sections.body:
They: We get enough work from word of mouth.
You: That's the best kind of work. The thing is, word of mouth still looks you up before they ring. What do they find when they do?

They: I'm not interested.
You: Fair enough, most folk aren't till they know why I'm calling. Quick one before I go: is getting found online something you've got covered?

They: Send me an email.
You: Will do. So I don't send you something you'll bin, what matters more to you right now, more enquiries or less time on the phone?

They: How much is it?
You: Depends what you need. It's a one-off build and then a small monthly. I'd rather show you first than throw a number at you. Fifteen minutes, I could pop in?

They: Don't call me again.
You: No problem, I'll take you off. Sorry for the interruption, all the best. _(Log as Do not call)_

sections.label: Voicemail
sections.body: Hi Taylor, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One in Edinburgh. I'm calling about your website, great drone photos but no reviews on show. I'll drop you a text with what I mean. You can get me back on this number. Again, it's Dean from Level One. Cheers.

sections.label: When they say yes
sections.body:
Brilliant. Let me read that back to you. _(say the day and time back)_ Is this the best number for you, or is there a mobile?
I'll text you now so you've got my number. I'll bring the screenshots of who comes up for roofers in Falkirk.
